brief:
Israeli soldiers stopped a vehicle driven by a young woman, forced her out, and confiscated it during a large-scale military raid in the town of Al-Shuyukh, north of Hebron, Eye on Palestine reported. The incident occurred as part of the broader military operation in the area.

No additional details about the raid's scope, duration, or other activities were immediately available.
